@jinshu.view.media.cannotPlay.description: Audio card status when playback failed.

@jinshu.view.media.notPlayedYet.description: Why a chapter button is unavailable: seeking is limited to what has been played.

@jinshu.view.resume.description: Button in the resume bar that jumps to the last reading position.

@jinshu.view.resumeAt.description: Resume bar above the document; heading is the start of the block last read.

@jinshu.view.resumeHere.description: Resume bar above the document when the last block read has no title text.

@jinshu.view.retry.description: Button that loads a failed image or audio again.

@jinshu.view.task.description: Accessible name of a task checkbox whose item has no text.

@jinshu.view.unavailable.description: Shown in place of a document that could not be loaded.

@jinshu.view.video.blocked.defaultMessage: This video's address is blocked by the security policy
@jinshu.view.video.blocked.description: Shown in place of a video whose address is not allowed.

@jinshu.view.video.label.description: Accessible name of a video with no caption.

@jinshu.view.video.playedOnly.defaultMessage: You can only seek to parts you've already watched
@jinshu.view.video.playedOnly.description: Note under a video that may only seek within what was played.
